visual_elements.description: Callout rectangle with light-peach fill and orange border, 4 centered bold lines: 'Both Encoder and Decoder Blocks Contain' (black), '"Multi-Head Self Attention" block' (red), '"h" Heads' (red), 'Outputs of Heads are concatenated' (red). A thin gray connector line runs from this box down toward the Multi-Head Attention diagram near the 'h' annotation.

Scaled Dot-Product Attention (left): green (#00B050) rectangle border with small green square handles at the 4 corners. Bottom-to-top: three circles q (red), k (blue), v (blue); black arrows rise into a lavender 'MatMul' box; arrow up to yellow 'Scale'; arrow up to pink 'Mask (opt.)'; arrow up to light-green 'SoftMax'; arrow up to a second lavender 'MatMul' at top; a line from v runs up the right side into the top MatMul. Red bold-italic 2-line title 'Scaled Dot-Product / Attention' above the border.

Multi-Head Attention (center): green rectangle border with corner handles. Bottom-to-top: circles v (blue), k (blue), q (red); each feeds its own white 'Linear' box (three in a row); three arrows rise into a stack of offset 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' boxes (gray/pink copies behind suggesting h parallel heads; front copy pink with red border and a yellow highlight rectangle behind it); arrow up to yellow 'Concat' box; arrow up to white 'Linear' box at top. Small curved arrow from the stack to an italic 'h' label on the right. Red bold-italic title 'Multi-Head Attention' above the border.

Full Encoder-Decoder Transformer (right): large green rectangle border with corner handles; left ~55% is a peach Encoder panel, right ~45% a light-green Decoder panel; red bold-italic labels 'Encoder' (top-left) and 'Decoder' (top-right). Encoder stack bottom-to-top: solid red up-arrow + text 'Inputs'; brown 'Input Embedding' box with a circle-plus (⊕) symbol above it and black label 'Positional Encoding' to the left; circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); tan 'Multi-Head Attention' box with red border and yellow highlight rectangle behind it; tan 'Add & Norm'; tan 'Feed Forward'; tan 'Add & Norm'; gray circle 'N×' at top-right. Decoder stack bottom-to-top: yellow-highlighted text 'Outputs (shifted right)'; dark-red 'Output Embedding' box with ⊕ above and label 'Positional Encoding' to the right; circles V, K, Q; purple 'Masked Multi-Head Attention'; tan 'Add & Norm'; purple 'Multi-Head Attention' with red border (circles V, K, Q below it); tan 'Add & Norm'; tan 'Feed Forward'; tan 'Add & Norm'; light-green 'Linear'; light-green 'Softmax'; yellow-highlighted text 'Output Probabilities' with solid red up-arrow at top; gray circle 'N×' at the right of the middle Multi-Head Attention. Black up-arrows connect successive layers in both stacks.

Red dashed curved arrow from the top of the encoder stack curving right and down into the decoder's middle 'Multi-Head Attention' (arrowhead at its V/K circles) carrying encoder output to cross-attention; second red dashed curved arrow along the right edge from near 'Outputs (shifted right)' curving up to 'Output Probabilities' (autoregressive feedback); solid red up-arrows at 'Inputs' (bottom of encoder) and 'Output Probabilities' (top of decoder).
visual_elements.position: right diagram and spanning encoder-to-decoder gap

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title ~36pt bold red, sentence case with en dash. Callout text ~16pt bold; first line black, remaining lines red. Diagram titles ~14-16pt bold italic red ('Scaled Dot-Product Attention' wraps to two lines). Node labels ~9-10pt bold black, centered in boxes. Letters inside circles ~9pt bold italic white. 'h' and 'N×' italic. No serif fonts, no numbered bullets, no underlines.
